reason: PHP 75,000 with a refund is small money for a chain our size, but I'd have to walk into head office in a cost-cutting quarter and ask them to hand our CCTV and POS data to a company with zero results. I don't spend my credibility on that this month.
objection: No track record. A refund gives me my fee back, but it doesn't give me back the eight weeks, the store managers' time or the privacy risk of a stranger connecting to our cameras and sales data. And if it does work, PHP 3,000 a store a month across the chain is a very big recurring number for the board to swallow.
would_change_my_mind: A real result from one other Philippine chain, in pesos with a payback period, plus a written cap or tiered price for rolling out past the test stores.
